findings.relevance: Holds the retry loop: it retries up to MAX_ATTEMPTS, breaks out on any 4xx, and falls through to the dead-letter record when the attempts run out.
Owns the retry timing: BASE_DELAY_MS, MAX_ATTEMPTS, and delayFor, which doubles the delay each attempt.
Where an event that never succeeded ends up: recordDeadLetter appends it to the store that deadLetters reads back.

relationships.relationship: imports delayFor and MAX_ATTEMPTS from, so the backoff schedule and the attempt ceiling both come from there
calls recordDeadLetter in, once the retry loop is exhausted or a 4xx breaks it
